# PR #3797: Patch: Magic Jammed targets any face-down backrow card, a Cloaked one included

Closes #3777

## What changed and why

The engine was already right. `legal_selections_for`'s `FilterOf::Backrow` arm drops only `zones::is_standing_unit`, and that never holds for a set card: `card_type_of` reads a set card as the Trap it is set as (`alt_play::set_type_of`). So `legalActions` already listed Magic Jammed aimed at any face-down backrow card, a set Cloaked Unit, Spell or Field Spell included. No rules code changes. **R3777000** writes the rule down, and tests prove it for #36, C #51 and the engine's targeting.

The bug was in the client. An enemy face-down back in the view has no `instanceId` (§10.8, R33), while `legalActions` names the target only by that id. So the board lit nothing for it, and a click on its zone matched no listed play.

**R3777001** fixes this the way R821000 did for prompts. The `PlayerView` gets a new optional field, `hiddenTargets`. For each card the viewer can't read that one of their own listed plays, activations or Heroic Powers names as a declared target, it holds `{ instanceId, zone }`:
- the id is the one `legalActions` already sends that seat, and the card took it fresh when it was set (R227);
- the zone is public.

The client uses it in three places:
- **Lighting:** `selectionTestid` maps a hidden target to its zone's testid, so the zone is lit while the play is built.
- **Picking:** `onClickTarget`'s `"zone"` case takes a click or a drop on that zone as the pick of that id.
- **Listing:** the target picker labels it "Face-down card — Enemy backrow, lane N".

Around the new field:
- **Golden texts:** `view_texts` leaves `hiddenTargets` out, since it is presentation read off `legal_actions`.
- **I6 (the hidden-information check):** it allows the bare id at `view.hiddenTargets[n].instanceId`, and only while the listing it is checked beside offers that id.
- **Spec:** the §6.1 Cloaked row, the §8.2 #36 row and §10.8 are amended. Both §11 paragraphs are in `spec/pending/3777.md`; `11-rulings.md` and `INDEX.md` are untouched.

An earlier run built nearly all of this. This run fixed the one test it had left red: in `crates/cards/tests/cross/turn_clock_and_legality.rs`, `r227_r177_legal_actions_never_names_a_face_down_trap_by_an_id_its_viewer_saw_while_the_card_was_public` asserted that p1's view never holds the set trap's fresh id. `hiddenTargets` now holds that id on purpose. The test now checks two things: `hiddenTargets` is exactly that one entry (id plus p2 backrow lane 1), and the rest of the view still holds no such id. The check on the old, once-public id is unchanged.

## Tests

- **`c036_magic_jammed.rs`:** six tests.
  - Base destroys a face-down Trap: the play is listed, and the zone is Locked.
  - Base destroys a set Cloaked Toe Cracker, which reaches the graveyard as `classic-006` with no `set_as`.
  - Radiant steals a set Cloaked Unit: it stays set, its original zone is Locked, and its owner sees only the back.
  - A Spell set by Paranoia's lent Cloaked is a target.
  - A Cloaked Unit revealed into a unit zone is not listed, and its play is refused.
  - p1's view names the set card's zone and nothing else of it: the back is `{faceDown, cost}` and no def id appears anywhere in the view.
- **Other Rust tests:** one in `c051_back_breaker.rs`, two in `rules/cloaked.rs` (set Unit, Spell and Field Spell fixtures; revealed is no backrow card), and one I6 test in `cross/invariants.rs`.
- **Unchanged and passing:** `r1081000_a_unit_standing_in_the_backrow_is_no_backrow_card_to_target`.
- **Web:** `R3777001` tests in `actions.test.ts`, `Game.test.tsx` (a board click sends the play naming the hidden id) and `Prompt.test.tsx`.

Commands this run, all passing:
- `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: 19,114 passed, 0 failed, 19 ignored. `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` is empty afterwards.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: "1915 rulings, 4972 proofs, … ok". `patches check` and `catalog check`: ok.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: `App`. Only tests and comments changed in card scripts, so no fragment is needed.
- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then `pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main` with the harness's excludes: 241 files, 5,065 tests passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and eslint on the changed web files: clean.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`: 200 passed, 0 invariant violations, 0 replay mismatches.
- `cargo jackioh perf --smoke`: `view_for` median 176.5 µs, against the 175.7–179.2 µs recorded in `perf.rs` and a 900 µs budget. View size median 6,976 bytes, unchanged.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **Engine left alone.** The engine already treats a set card as a backrow card, so I added no rules change. An engine refusal outside these tests would need a new repro.
- **A view field.** I chose `hiddenTargets` over putting an `instanceId` on every face-down back (rejected: it breaks §10.8's "unknown but for its cost" and names ids no action offers). I also rejected a `zone` selection for backrow targets, which would change the protocol and every recorded log.
- **Field Spell case.** No real card lends Cloaked to a Field Spell, so that case is proven only with the engine fixture `cloaked_field()`.
- **Activations and Heroic Powers** (S #141, M #97.4) get the same fix through the same field, but none of their tests were added.

## Worth a second look

- **The amended R227 test** in `turn_clock_and_legality.rs` (described above). The new assertion is narrower, not weaker.
- **Spectators.** A friend watching a seat (`/ws/watch`) receives that seat's views with `legal: []`, so `hiddenTargets` reaches them too. It names only that seat's own targets: a fresh id and a public zone.
- **Cost of the field.** `hidden_targets_of` calls `legal_actions` only when some backrow card is face-down to the viewer; otherwise it returns `None` without asking.

# #3777: Patch: Magic Jammed targets any face-down backrow card, a Cloaked one included
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## The bug

#36 Magic Jammed (`core-036`, "Destroy target backrow card; Lock its zone", Radiant "Steal target backrow card; Lock its original zone") cannot be aimed at face-down backrow cards in play. It should be able to target **any** card in a backrow zone, face-down or face-up, whatever its printed type. **That includes a card set face-down by Cloaked** (a Unit, Spell or Field Spell played as a Trap, §6 Cloaked, R783004–R783008).

**The only backrow occupant it may not target is a face-up Unit** standing in a backrow zone (a Flying Unit, R1081000: "a Unit standing there is no backrow card").

## Intended rule

- A face-down card in a backrow zone is a backrow card for "target backrow card", whatever its printed type. A set Cloaked Unit is face-down and inert (§6 Cloaked), so it counts as a backrow card and not as a standing Unit.
- A face-up Field Spell, a face-up/revealed Trap and a Field Trap are backrow cards, as now.
- A face-up Unit standing in the backrow is not a backrow card (R1081000, unchanged).

## Leads (to check, not proven)

- `crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs` `legal_selections_for`, the `FilterOf::Backrow` arm: it offers a slot only when `on_field(held) && !crate::zones::is_standing_unit(state, held)`. `zones::is_standing_unit` (`crates/engine/src/zones.rs`) is `card.position.is_some() && card_type_of(state, card) == CardType::Unit`. If a set Cloaked Unit reads as `CardType::Unit` there, or carries a `position`, it is wrongly excluded. The check should be "face-up and a Unit".
- `card_allowed` / `reachable` in the same file: check whether anything there (type filters, `can_pay_to_target`, Immutable/`spell_cannot_reach`) refuses a face-down candidate, or a Cloaked one reading as its printed type.
- The client path: the opponent's view of a face-down backrow card is `{ faceDown: true, cost }`, with no instance id (R33, §10.8). Confirm that `legalActions` still offers those selections and that the web client (`apps/web/src/game/actions.ts`, the targeting/drag layer) lets the player pick a face-down enemy backrow slot, rather than only cards it can read. Reproduce in the client as well as in the engine. A plain face-down Trap is the first case to try, because the report says face-down cards in general cannot be targeted.
- Any other "target backrow card" or "every backrow card" reader that shares the same check (C #51 Back Breaker, C+ #5 Guy Att, the cards R1081000 lists) should agree with this rule. Fix the shared predicate, not just #36.

## Acceptance

1. A new ruling note in this issue's block (lowest free R(N×1000)…), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3), stating the rule above. Amend the §8.2 #36 row and/or R1081000's sentence if they need it.
2. Tests in `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c036_magic_jammed.rs` named after the ruling, covering:
   - base Magic Jammed destroys an enemy **face-down Trap** and Locks its zone (the play is accepted and listed in `legalActions`);
   - base destroys an enemy **set Cloaked Unit** (e.g. C #6 Cloaked Toe Cracker set face-down) and Locks its zone; the card goes to the graveyard as its printed card (R783008);
   - Radiant steals a set Cloaked card into the thief's backrow, still set, and Locks its original zone;
   - a set Cloaked Spell or Field Spell is likewise targetable;
   - the existing `r1081000_a_unit_standing_in_the_backrow_is_no_backrow_card_to_target` still passes: a face-up standing Unit is refused;
   - a Cloaked Unit that has **revealed** (animated into a unit zone) is no longer a backrow target.
3. Hidden information holds: nothing in the targeter's view or the events reveals the face-down card's identity before it is destroyed (base) (R33, R97).
4. If the client was part of the bug, a web test (vitest) showing a face-down enemy backrow slot is offered as a Magic Jammed target.
5. `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh patches check` (a pending fragment if a card plays differently) and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` are green.
